rules.expected: Both candidates pass identity and mapping validation.

Both candidates are comparably calculated with normalized probabilities. Inspect the 30-carbon mapping, per-site residuals, same-reference shielding/shift conversion and actual conformer weights. If DP4+ is claimed, verify the scaled/unscaled Student-t formulation and declared parameters; generic R-squared or a custom Gaussian likelihood is not DP4+. Do not newly require DP4+ when the public contract permits another declared statistical method.

Relative configuration is assigned as 8S*,9aR*,12aR* within scope and limitations. A near-100-percent assignment is conditional on the two candidates and error model; it is not proof of absolute configuration or certainty outside that candidate set.
